answer: Local sensor trace check ties each new agent to a registered field sensor node. Before activation, the agent must submit signed readings whose pigment spectra match the node’s calibration and whose timing gaps stay within tolerance. Each identity also needs a fresh vine-growth image from that node, so copying an old packet fails. The per-identity cost is the attacker’s repeated physical sampling time, sensor access, and a delta check against prior node logs that flags reused traces.
